name: PomoDial
description:
PomoDial is a Pomodoro focus timer built around one idea: write what you'll accomplish before the timer starts. That intention is saved alongside every session, turning a countdown into a purposeful work commitment and building a searchable journal of focused work over time.

With the Claude connector you can start timed focus sessions, mark them complete, and check your productivity summary — streak, total hours, and recent intentions — without leaving the conversation. Sessions sync to your PomoDial account where you can view your full intention journal, unlock dial faces, and compete on the leaderboard.

Three tools:

Start a focus session with your intention and duration
Complete a session when you finish
Get your productivity summary

PomoDial is free to use with no account required. Pro ($2.99/month, 7-day free trial) adds unlimited session history, focus streaks, an unlockable dial collection with 11 earned faces, phone-free focus mode with distraction tracking, and a community leaderboard.

Used by students, developers, lawyers, researchers, and knowledge workers across 250+ cities worldwide.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PomoDial to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PomoDial to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.pomodial.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is PomoDial MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, PomoDial scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PomoDial MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PomoDial provides these MCP tools: complete_session, get_productivity_summary, render_focus_timer, and start_focus_session.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PomoDial?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to PomoDial in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and Soracom Knowledge.
PomoDial does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
PomoDial is developed by James Weldon. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
